preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value ai is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The list a contains exactly n elements, one for each vertex.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(max(a[x-1], a[y-1]) - min(a[x-1], a[y-1]) for x, y in edges))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values of the two vertices connected by each edge in the tree.
